parsed.why: State-level protections: full gender-identity nondiscrimination incl. public accommodations, no facility ban, hate-crime enhancement, panic defence repealed, low-risk tier; national passport/document regime still applies, capping the score below Low Risk.

Moderate-risk tier: no adult facility ban, but no statewide nondiscrimination covering visitors, no gender-identity hate-crime enhancement, district bathroom ban and board-driven restrictions; national document regime unchanged — essentially the parent picture.

Most-Protective tier: public-accommodations protection, gender-neutral single-occupancy restrooms, no facility or sports ban, hate-crime coverage, shield law for out-of-state care, no-surgery marker change; only the national passport regime pulls it down.

Adult care capacity cancelled at one hospital citing state and national law, documented epidemic-level violence (raw counts, no denominator), minor-care ban; no division facility ban or custody exposure documented — near parent, slightly tempered by care-denial risk.

Worst features at top tiers: mob beating with victims charged and no attackers arrested, denial of hospital care, men's-jail placement and male-guard search despite female marker, severe municipal restroom ordinance, surgical-proof marker changes, no GI discrimination law.
